fusions.name: All Paws on Deck
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Rouse the Watch
fusions.desc: Bays through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to every enemy in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Welcome Back Aboard
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. For 4 seconds after, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Quarterdeck Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound keeps your watch and fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
